Font Awesome Free — vendored subset
===================================

What this is
------------
A minimal, self-hosted subset of Font Awesome Free used by this app:

  fontawesome.min.css           curated stylesheet: @font-face (woff2 only),
                                .fa/.fas/.far base+family classes, .fa-xs,
                                and :before glyph rules for exactly the
                                fa-* classes still referenced in src/.
  webfonts/fa-solid-900.woff2   solid style (used via .fa and .fas)
  webfonts/fa-regular-400.woff2 regular style (used via .far)
  fontawesome-UPSTREAM-LICENSE.txt  verbatim LICENSE.txt from the upstream
                                package

Source
------
Package:  @fortawesome/fontawesome-free
Version:  5.15.4  (chosen because the app templates use Font Awesome 5
          primary class names, e.g. fa-check-circle, fa-ellipsis-h,
          fa-external-link-alt)
Registry: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free
Upstream: https://fontawesome.com
Extracted via `npm pack @fortawesome/fontawesome-free@5.15.4`; css rules
          copied verbatim from css/all.css of that package.

What was intentionally NOT vendored
-----------------------------------
- webfonts: eot / woff / ttf / svg variants dropped — woff2 is supported by
  all evergreen browsers; the dead-upstream kit previously loaded is gone.
- fa-brands-400 (no .fab usage anywhere in src/), light style, SVG/JS
  framework files, and all glyph rules for icons the app does not use.
